name: stripe tease chocolate cake
ingredients_raw: CAKE BASE (APPROX 75 %): EGGS, REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, WATER, COCOA SOLIDS(1.06%), MALTODEXTRIN, CORN STARCH, IODISED SALT, HUMECTANTS(INS422, INS1520), EMULSIFIERS (INS435, INS471, INS491), ACIDITY REGULATOR(INS260), CREAM-(APPROX 25%):HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE OILS(PALMOLEIN, PALM OIL, PALM KERNEL OIL), SESAME OIL, INVERT SYRUP, COCOA SOLIDS (0.44%), IODIZED SALT, CONTAINS CLASS II PRESERVATIVES (INS282,INS200), CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOR(INS 150(d)), CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES [CHOCOLATE AND VANILLA].VITAMIN A.
